text.p01: To best friends like Felix and Finn. A story about friendship and forgiveness.
text.p03: In a quiet forest, under the golden autumn leaves, lived two foxes named Felix and Finn.
text.p04: They were the best of friends and did everything together.
text.p05: They raced through the woods, shared tasty fruits, and even built cozy dens side by side.
text.p06: One day, Felix found a shiny, round pebble by the river
text.p08: Felix placed the pebble in his den, proud of his special find.
text.p09: But the next day, it was gone!
text.p10: Felix rushed to Finn’s den and saw a shiny pebble sitting by the entrance.
text.p11: “Finn, you took my pebble!” Felix shouted.
text.p13: This is my pebble. I found it near the oak tree!”
text.p14: But Felix didn’t believe him. “You’re lying!” he growled.
text.p15: Angry and hurt, the two foxes turned their backs on each other and stormed off
text.p16: Days passed, but neither fox felt happy.
text.p17: The forest felt emptier without their laughter and adventures.
text.p18: One evening, Felix was walking by the river
text.p19: he saw something sparkling in the water. It was his pebble!
text.p20: Felix realized he had been wrong.
text.p21: The pebble must have rolled out of his den and into the river.
text.p22: Feeling ashamed, Felix knew he had to make things right
text.p24: “Finn,” Felix said softly, “I found my pebble by the river.
text.p25: I’m so sorry for not believing you.”
text.p26: Finn looked at Felix, his eyes softening.
text.p27: “I was really hurt, Felix. But I forgive you.”
text.p28: The two foxes hugged tightly. “Friends?” Felix asked.
text.p30: From that day on, Felix and Finn knew that mistakes could happen,
text.p31: but forgiveness made their friendship even stronger.
